items.authored_reason: The OBC spectral density is independently regenerated from exact diagonalization at the paper's L=1000, 3200-realization scale.
Representative ALM, critical, and skin profiles are selected by independent numerical search rather than source-image tracing.
The Lyapunov density and essential-exponent mobility contour are generated from the transfer-matrix formulation with independent grids.
Potential convergence exponents are independently fit against system size using the documented paper-matched configuration.
The PBC spectral density is independently regenerated from exact diagonalization at the paper scale.
The PBC Lyapunov density and winding-sector labels are independently generated and cross-checked against direct twisted-boundary winding.
The mobility-edge contours for the five published disorder strengths are independently generated from the essential Lyapunov exponent.
The ALM-fraction curve and the Wc ≈ 2.1 threshold are independently regenerated from exact diagonalization plus Lyapunov classification.

The off-diagonal Hatano-Nelson theory density and mobility edge are independently generated from the published Hamiltonian. Because the paper does not publish its exact rendering grid, this item remains fidelity-capped rather than deferred.
The off-diagonal OBC spectral density is independently regenerated at reduced scale from exact diagonalization under the published parameters.
Representative ALM and skin profiles are selected by an independent Lyapunov-sign rule at reduced scale. The unpublished author windows cap fidelity but do not block scientific reproduction.
The quasiperiodic theory density and mobility edge are independently generated from the published Hatano-Nelson Hamiltonian with onsite modulation.
The quasiperiodic OBC spectral density is independently regenerated from exact diagonalization at reduced scale under the published model parameters.
Representative ALM and skin profiles are independently selected from the Lyapunov-classified quasiperiodic spectrum; the unpublished author windows cap fidelity but do not block reproduction.
The rho_OBC=rho_w limit is independently checked from the triangular OBC Hamiltonian and finite eigenvalue histograms.

Matched-precision ED and QR errors are computed against an independently generated 256-bit ED reference; the reduced pilot is not promoted to the paper-scale ordering claim.
The two-factor precision/size implementation exists and the pilot records a resource projection; the publication-scale sweep is not claimed as run.
The paper's L=50..400 grid and L=1000 reference at E0 are executed from independently sampled disorder.
An exponential fit is compared against a power-law alternative; the current result is preserved even when it does not resolve the paper claim.

uncovered_item_details.paper_location: Published Supplement Fig. S3, E=-0.72 series
direct_gap_statements: T007 has complete code and a measured arbitrary-precision pilot, but the published L=1000 by 1600-realization campaign was not run, so the Fig. S3 precision ordering is not adjudicated.

direct_cause.statement: T007 has complete code and a measured arbitrary-precision pilot, but the published L=1000 by 1600-realization campaign was not run, so the Fig. S3 precision ordering is not adjudicated.

root_cause.statement: The measured dense arbitrary-precision pilot projects the paper-scale sweep to about 3,629 local CPU days. The 112-256-bit reference contract cannot be supplied by a standard A100 FP32/FP64 path; even an optimistic 50x idealized speedup would still require about 73 days. This is a compute and arithmetic-capability boundary, not missing implementation.

code_fault_assessment.statement: Independent high-precision ED and QR paths execute and return finite matched-observable outputs on the pilot.

checks.statement: Both arbitrary-precision implementations execute on a frozen small-chain contract.
The pilot ran in isolation with every declared input read and no forbidden accesses.
Measured pilot runtime was scaled by dense-ED cubic and ensemble factors; the benchmark also records why the available A100 does not natively close the 112-256-bit contract.

next_discriminating_test.action: Run the frozen L=1000, 1600-realization precision campaign on a suitable high-throughput arbitrary-precision compute backend.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: The run will either reproduce the Fig. S3 precision ordering or convert the target into an attempted discrepancy.

next_discriminating_actions: Run the frozen L=1000, 1600-realization precision campaign on a suitable high-throughput arbitrary-precision compute backend.

direct_gap_statements: T008 executes the published energy and length grid, and none of 18 declared seed/ensemble/QR protocols meets the paper's exponential-decay feature contract.

direct_cause.statement: T008 executes the published energy and length grid, and none of 18 declared seed/ensemble/QR protocols meets the paper's exponential-decay feature contract.

root_cause.statement: The non-match survives three ensemble sizes, three seeds, and two QR intervals. This supports a probable paper-claim discrepancy, but only fresh-context claim review may confirm a paper-error candidate.

code_fault_assessment.statement: The observable is rederived, unit-tested, independently implemented, protocol-swept, and produced by an isolated clean-room run.

checks.statement: The implementation evaluates the published central Lyapunov-gap deviation against the L=1000 reference.
The gap-scaling path returns finite deviations and fit diagnostics on an independent small contract.
Eighteen seed/ensemble/QR protocols were tested; zero satisfied the frozen exponential feature contract.
The published S4 energy/length contract and the omitted ensemble/stabilization fields are recorded separately.
The clean-room QR/Lyapunov implementation was derived from the paper equations without author code, arrays, or pixels.
The full grid and sensitivity sweep ran in isolation without reading paper pixels or author data.

next_discriminating_test.action: Have a fresh reviewer rederive the observable and run an independent implementation, including an alternative averaging order.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: Independent persistence would support paper_error_candidate; a recovered line would expose the missing protocol or an author-side method defect.
